## Checklist / 检查表

- [ ] This is practice curation or a factual correction, not a bulk link dump.
- [ ] I personally opened and verified every source, command, and claimed result.
- [ ] Descriptions explain why an item is useful; popularity is not the reason.
- [ ] I distinguished source review from hands-on testing and endorsement.
- [ ] I disclosed lifecycle scripts, execution authority, and external data flow.
- [ ] English and Chinese peers have matching `sync:` markers and facts.
- [ ] Resource membership/status has matching markers and registry records.
- [ ] I ran `npm run check` and inspected rendered Markdown.
- [ ] I ran `npm run check:awesome`, or explained the local remote-metadata limitation.
- [ ] No credentials, private source/session content, identifiers, or sensitive logs are included.
- [ ] The Markdown is human-reviewed and not a fully AI-generated pull request.
- [ ] I agree to contribute this work under CC0-1.0.
